_comment: Published all-time rankings, transcribed as ordered lists. This file is evidence, not a target: nothing here is fitted against, and no formula weight may be chosen to move a player named in it. 'all_time' lists set the tiers; a 'current_form' list ranks the players active when it was written, so it can admit an active player to tier C and can never place one in tier A or B.
